title: The item had a chemical smell. Lightweight coverlet
text: The item had a chemical smell. Lightweight coverlet. I had to wash this coverlet twice to get rid of the chemical smell.  It still has a little bit of the odor, but very faint.  I will wash it again.  It lays out smoothly and fits well.  It looks nice on the bed.  It's lightweight, which I love!
